text.value: In 2009, the Australian comedy group “Axis of Awesome” performed a viral sketch showing that a surprising number of pop songs – from Journey’s “Don’t Stop Believing” to Beyoncé’s “If I Were A Boy” – are built off of the same 4 chords.

stage.caption: All the greatest hits from the last 40 years just use 4 chords. Same 4 chords for every song, it’s dead simple to write a pop hit.

text.value: Chords provide the harmonic foundation for a song, so people cite this video as proof that all pop music is formulaic and sounds the same. The sheer volume of songs makes a compelling case.

li: built on a single four-chord progression 🧱
